Chapter one

Our Little Love Story ♡

Not every love story needs to be perfect. It just needs two hearts that keep choosing each other.

When our story began 🌙

Some people enter your life and quietly make everything feel a little more beautiful. Hunaiza, you became one of my favourite parts of every day. And somehow, five months with you already feel like a collection of moments I never want to forget.

Little moments, big feelings 💗

It's the smiles, the random conversations, the tiny details and the way one message from you can change my whole mood. Maybe love is made of these little things—and I'm grateful I get to share them with you.

Chapter three

A Little Letter for You 💌

There's something I wanted you to read. Open the envelope when you're ready.

My dearest Hunaiza,

Happy five months to us, my love. ❤️ Five months might sound like a small number, but every day with you has added something beautiful to my heart. Thank you for the smiles, the conversations, the care, and all the little moments that mean more to me than I can explain. I don't expect every day to be perfect. I just hope that, through every happy moment and every difficult one, we keep listening to each other, understanding each other, and choosing each other with kindness. You are special to me in ways words can never fully describe. This little website is just one small way of saying that I'm happy our paths crossed, and I'm excited for all the memories we have yet to make. Here's to five months of us—and to many more chapters in our story. 🌙💗

Forever yours,
Arsalan ♥
